specs.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset: a production terrain texture atlas for a Three Kingdoms mobile strategy game, three equal vertical panels side by side in ONE 3072x1536 landscape image. Each panel is a portrait 1024x1536 game battlefield ground. Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its cinematic hand-painted realism, charcoal stone, weathered earth, muted vegetation, warm amber grazing light, somber ancient-war atmosphere. Do NOT reproduce its people or city gate. Left panel: autumn north-China battlefield, charcoal ochre muddy earth and sparse faded grass. Middle: winter battlefield, cold ash-gray earth and patchy frost, no bright white snow blanket. Right: dry frontier battlefield, desaturated brown dust and eroded dark shale, no bright orange dunes. Camera fixed elevated 3/4 looking down, nearly orthographic game-map ground, no sky or horizon. All three panels have a broad OPEN playable center from 15% to 85% width and 12% to 90% height; subtle worn earth mottling, scattered tiny gravel, believable low-contrast material texture there. The extreme side edges and corners have large rough grey rock faces, wind-bent pines and sparse scrub, forming framing depth, NOT isolated miniature rock icons. Faint smoke haze only along the distant top edge. Same scale and lighting in all three panels. No buildings, camps, troops, people, flags, roads, paths, rivers, bridges, grids, text, buttons or UI anywhere. Not a clean board-game field, not clay miniature, not flat vector art, not oversaturated. No strong dark patches in center. Each panel seamless within itself, straight clean vertical panel cuts at one-third and two-thirds.

Use case: historical-scene. Asset: isolated transparent RGBA production sprite atlas, square 2048x2048, STRICT 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 separate subjects with generous transparent gutters, NO grid lines. Input 1 STYLE REFERENCE: match its realistic hand-painted Han-era gray stone gate, soot-black tiles, raw timber, worn linen, lamellar iron, dust and warm firelight. Input 2 is LAYOUT / SUBJECT REFERENCE ONLY for the existing atlas. Preserve column order and tier structure but replace its toy-like identical neat courtyards with convincing occupied military forts, ragged earth edges, massive front gateways and uneven timber structures, strong silhouette readable at 60 pixels. Three-quarter elevated view; roofs not oversized. Every cell isolated, no ground pedestal or square cutout. Column 1 infantry shield/spear barracks, col2 archer camp with clear circular straw targets and bow racks, col3 cavalry stable with visible brown horses and hay, col4 tall independent watchtower with defensive fence (not archer camp). ROW1 level1: rough sharpened wooden stockade, canvas awnings, rough small timber gate; ROW2 level2: thicker rammed-earth/gray-stone gate wall and a modest roofed gatehouse; ROW3 level3: imposing heavy grey masonry fortified gate with twin towers (tower column is one much taller keep); distinct tier silhouettes. Low-saturation neutral gray roofs, smoke-aged timber, pale tan canvas and shields. Small unmarked pale hanging cloth at front gateway for game tinting, no colored faction roofing. Tiny restrained warm lantern in each gateway. Entire subject including pole tips/horse feet inside its cell; no clipping or bleed into neighbors. ROW4 four single adult ancient soldiers in matching gritty style: spear+round shield infantry, longbow archer, armored horse rider, heavy rectangular shield guard, facing right at 3/4. Keep bottom row separate from building gutters. No words, no glyphs, no logos, no user interface, no large smoke plume, no magic, no medieval European buildings. TRUE transparent background, no checkerboard baked into pixels.

Use case: historical-scene. Asset: seven hand-painted military object illustrations on a TRUE transparent background, strict 4-column 2-row atlas, landscape 2048x1024, generous transparent gutters, no panel borders, no writing. Reference image 1 supplies cinematic Three Kingdoms war realism, worn raw wood, dark iron, frayed linen, weathered bronze, subdued charcoal and ochre with warm amber edges. These are large close-up tangible objects, NOT small troop miniatures, flat app icons, cute objects or glossy fantasy UI. Each object centered in its own equal square cell, strong silhouette readable at 48px, 10% padding, no overlap. Top row left to right: (1) battered ancient bronze military calling horn with dark red tassel and leather wrapping, for troop conscription; (2) worn marching boots beside a rolled travel bundle and small unmarked dispatch pennant, for forced marching of ANY troop type, no horse; (3) bundle of three long steel spearheads and a round battered wooden shield, for local militia reinforcement; (4) black earthenware fire-oil jar with burning linen fuse and a small realistic orange flame, for production disruption. Bottom row left to right: (5) tied sheaf of golden grain with small rough cloth provisions sack, for farming; (6) dark iron horseshoe with leather reins and brass fitting, for speed; (7) rugged wooden palisade section with timber brace and bundled rope, for capacity expansion; (8) completely empty transparent cell. Lighting upper left; material details broad and tactile, edges irregular and scuffed. No human figures, no architecture, no landscape, no text or numerals, no magical glow, no duplicated subject. Actual transparent alpha around all objects.
